title: pulmonaria officinalis subsp. saccharata
intro: Pulmonaria officinalis subsp. saccharata, commonly known as Lungwort, is a perennial plant species in the borage family native to Europe. It is valued for its medicinal properties, primarily for its ability to soothe and calm respiratory tract issues, such as bronchitis and coughs. The health benefits of Lungwort include its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to ease congestion and promote the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of Pulmonaria officinalis subsp. saccharata include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including expectoration and anti-inflammatory effects.
